courses.overview: 從邊界電流、CT 飽和與差動制動延伸至相近領域；相似物理不代表同一設備規格或驗收程序。
courses.overviewEn: Extend boundary currents, ct saturation and differential restraint to neighboring domains; shared physics does not imply identical equipment requirements or acceptance procedures.

related.title: 輸電距離保護
related.why: 都需驗證外部故障不誤動
related.transfer: 都需驗證外部故障不誤動
related.difference: 距離不必依賴同樣的端間電流比較
related.differenceEn: Distance need not use the same inter-end current comparison
practice: 以「區域邊界」為起點，畫出本課與「輸電距離保護」可共用及須重畫的系統邊界。
針對「距離不必依賴同樣的端間電流比較」各選一項能區分兩課的量測。
將本課算例移植到新情境：保留方程依據，重新指定單位、材料或拓撲，並標示無法沿用的數值。
practiceEn: Start from zone boundary and mark shared/redefined boundaries with transmission distance protection.
For the difference "Distance need not use the same inter-end current comparison", choose discriminating measurements for both courses.
Transfer the worked example: retain justified equations, respecify units, materials or topology and identify values that cannot transfer.
